## MacroPlot and Sample Event checks {.tabset .tabset-pills}

This document checks the plots that do not follow the 2 years on, 3 years off schedule, as well as the MacroPlot information that is created when a plot is added to the sampling rotation. Thus, this document doesn't need to be run annual.

```{r libs, include = F}
library(plantcomNGPN)
library(tidyverse) # dplyr, purrr, tidyr
library(knitr) # for kable and include_graphic()
library(kableExtra) # for custom kable features
library(sf) # for checking plot coords against park bounding boxes
library(data.table) # faster summarizing than dplyr for big datasets
library(DT) # much faster at making tables for large dfs than kable

all_years <- params$all_years
year_curr <- params$year_curr
year_range <- if(all_years == TRUE){2011:year_curr} else {year_curr}
year_hist <- 2011:(year_curr - 1)

```

### Plots off Schedule {.tabset}
```{r off_sched_plots, eval = F}
df_samp_off <- samp_events_off |> filter(park %in% parkcode) |> select(-park)

table_off_sched <- df_samp_off |>
  kable(format = 'html',
        align = 'c',
        caption = paste0('A table of all the NGPN PCM plots from **',
                         parkcode,
                         '** that are off the sample schedule. ',
                         'These need to be checked to make sure they should ',
                         'not be included in any analyses.')) |>
  kable_styling(fixed_thead = T,
                bootstrap_options = c("condensed",
                                      "striped"),
                full_width = T,
                position = 'left',
                font_size = 10) |>
  column_spec(1:ncol(df_samp_off),
              border_left = "1px solid grey",
              border_right = "1px solid grey")

print(table_off_sched)
```

```{r, parktab_off, results = 'asis'}
for(i in seq_along(park_list_samp_off)){
  parkcode = park_list_samp_off[[i]]
  cat("#### ", parkcode, "{.tabset}", "\n\n")
  <<off_sched_plots>>
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r qc check}
QC_check_table
```

```{r macro, eval = macro_include, results = 'asis'}
check_null_print(kbl_macro_blanks, 4, "Blank Loc. Values")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_imp, 4, "Impossible Values")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_topo, 4, "UV1 Topo Positions")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_veg, 4, "UV4 Veg. Type")

cat("\n\n")
```
